responsibility: This file contains C-language-specific diagnostic helpers for standard-version pedantic and compatibility warnings. In particular it centralizes `pedwarn_c90`, `pedwarn_c99`, and `pedwarn_c11`, which decide whether a construct should be reported as a pedwarn, a version-compatibility warning, or suppressed based on the active language mode and option flags such as `-pedantic`, `-Wc90-c99-compat`, `-Wc99-c11-compat`, and `-Wc11-c2x-compat`.
